dedupe_keys.name: synthetic iso 20022 pacs 008 and pacs 009 payment message dataset for fraud detection and machine learning

description: A fully synthetic set of ISO 20022 payment messages of types pacs.008 (customer credit transfer) and pacs.009 (financial institution credit transfer), made for fraud detection and machine learning research. The IEEE DataPort page says the messages are schema-valid and built with a constraint-aware, schema-driven process that keeps amount distributions, timing between messages and consistency across messages, while containing no real customer, account or transaction data. It was created on 10 January 2026 and last updated on 15 January 2026 by Senthilnathan Dhanasekaran as an IEEE DataPort Standard Dataset, with data in CSV and XML; access needs an IEEE DataPort subscription, although DataCite lists CC BY 4.0. Coverage is synthetic and global in scope; the number of messages and file sizes are not stated on the page read. Caveats: behaviour is synthetic, the generator is not published on the page read, and download needs a subscription. For simulation it gives realistic message structures to test payment system software, fraud screening and message flows in models of high-value and cross-border payment systems. Related catalogue records include the BoF-PSS2 payment and settlement simulator and the BIS CPMI Red Book statistics.
